name: HSN Putrajaya 2026
short_description: HSN Putrajaya 2026 is a half-marathon held on October 10, 2026, at Dataran Putrajaya, Putrajaya, Malaysia.
ai_summary: HSN Putrajaya 2026 is a half-marathon event at Dataran Putrajaya in Putrajaya, Malaysia, held over 10-11 October 2026. The 30 km and 21.1 km run on Saturday 10 October, and the 10 km, 5 km and 3 km on Sunday 11 October. It is organised by The Concept Exhibition (M) Sdn Bhd with Jabatan Belia dan Sukan WPKL.

core_facts.organizer: The Concept Exhibition (M) Sdn Bhd with Jabatan Belia dan Sukan WPKL (JBSWPKL)

pros: Low entry fees: RM65 to RM90 for Malaysians in the 2025 half marathon
Cash prizes five deep in every 21 km and 10 km category, with medals to 10th
Separate Malaysian and over-40 categories give local runners more chances to place
Finisher medal for every distance and a finisher tee for the 21 km
cons: 2025 race-kit collection brought two-hour queues and shirts that had not arrived
No route map or aid-station plan on the 2025 registration pages
Humid: 89% to 94% humidity through the 2025 half marathon
Entries cannot be refunded, transferred or deferred

excerpt_quotes.quote: Pengambilan racekit larian HSN Putrajaya yang paling paling paling paling teruk..beratur 1.50 pm ambil masa 2 jam baju 5KM tak semua smpai lagi
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Participant post on Threads (@anas_coway) about the 2025 edition race kit collection

excerpt_quotes.quote: Lokasi Putrajaya yang terkenal dengan lanskap indah dan jalan yang terancang memberikan pengalaman larian yang sangat menyenangkan
Selain itu, suasana kebersamaan dan sokongan antara peserta amat menggalakkan semangat untuk terus maju ke garis penamat

research_highlights: The course runs through Dataran Putrajaya and the surrounding lakeside/park landscape, which participants describe as scenic and well laid out.
The event offers multiple distances (past editions had 3km/5km/10km/21km; the 2026 edition adds a 30km category alongside 3km/5km/10km/21km).
It's a two-day event at Dataran Putrajaya: in 2026 the 30km (3.30am) and 21km (5.00am) run on Saturday 10 October, and the 10km, 5km and 3km on Sunday 11 October.
Race kit collection in 2025 was held at Auditorium Tun Azizan Zainul in Kompleks Perbadanan Putrajaya; for 2026 the 3km, 5km and 10km kits are collected a week before the run at MITEC Kuala Lumpur.
Organisers position the event as a community-focused 'Car-Free Day' style carnival with an accompanying expo and bazaar.
research_watchouts: A participant reported extremely long queues (around 2 hours) at race kit collection for the 2025 edition, with some event t-shirts (including 5km and 21km sizes) not available/arriving in time.
The same participant reported having to collect shirts on the morning of the race itself due to stock/logistics issues, and criticized the organiser's system as lacking proper tracking.

faqs.question: When is HSN Putrajaya 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: HSN Putrajaya 2026 takes place over two days at Dataran Putrajaya. The 30 km and the 21.1 km half marathon are on Saturday 10 October 2026, with flag-offs at 3.30am and 5.00am, and the 10 km, 5 km and 3 km are on Sunday 11 October 2026, starting from 6.30am.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at HSN Putrajaya 2026?
faqs.answer: Participants at HSN Putrajaya 2026 can choose from several distance categories: 21.1km (the primary half-marathon distance), as well as 30km, 10km, 5km, and 3km options. This range allows both experienced long-distance runners and beginners or casual participants to find a suitable race distance.

faqs.question: Who organizes HSN Putrajaya 2026?
faqs.answer: The 2026 edition is run by The Concept Exhibition (M) Sdn Bhd, whose name appears on the official event site, together with Jabatan Belia dan Sukan WPKL, the Federal Territories youth and sports department that organised the 2025 edition. The event marks National Sports Day (Hari Sukan Negara) and is based at Dataran Putrajaya.
